notes.text: HTTP clients make REST calls to CHAT (FastAPI) and make REST calls to PUBLIC_API (FastAPI); web (Next.js 14) makes REST calls to INTERACTION (Flask).

CHAT (FastAPI), INTERACTION (Flask) and PUBLIC_API (FastAPI) read + write PostgreSQL; CHAT (FastAPI) also starts Temporal workflows; INTERACTION (Flask) also enqueues SQS tasks and makes API calls to Twilio; PUBLIC_API (FastAPI) also starts Temporal workflows.
Temporal workflows read + write PostgreSQL and make API calls to CRM + workspace APIs.
